title: Filter Visualizer
text: Display magnitude and phase response of time-varying digital filters, 2 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Style} sets Line style; {Num Filters} sets the number of filters to display, {Filter Type} sets the type of filter, {Legend} displays signal legend, {Magnitude Phase} plots magnitude and phase response of filter, {FFT Length}, {Normalized Frequency} displays the frequency response in normalized, {Sample Rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate in Hz, {Range} sets the frequency range, {Display Unit} sets the magnitude units, {Display Precision} sets the precision of data in scope display, {Title} displays title character vector, {X-Scale} scales of frequency, {Y-Limits} sets the y -axis limits, {Show Grid} shows internal grid lines, {Plot Type} sets the type of plot, {Font Size} sets the font size of labels, {Background} sets the window background, {Axes}, {Labels} sets the color of labels, {Line} sets the filter for line property settings filter, {Visible} sets the filter visibility, {Width} sets the line width, {Marker} sets the data point markers, {Color} sets the line color, {Copy to Clipboard} sets the send display, {Preserve Colors} sets the preserve colors when copying to clipboard, {Print}, {Channel} sets the filter for which to obtain measurements, {Data Cursors} enables cursor measurements, {Snap to data} sets the snap cursors to data, {Lock cursor spacing}, {Peak Finder} enables peak finder, {Num Peaks} sets the maximum number of peaks to show, {Min Height} sets the level above which scope detects, {Min Distance} sets the minimum number of samples between adjacent, {Threshold} sets the minimum difference in height of peak and its neighboring, {Label Peaks}, {Filter Names} sets the input filter names, {Maximize Axes} sets the maximize size of plots, {Axes Scaling} sets the y-axis scaling mode and {Number of Updates} sets the number of updates before scaling. Values come from the instance.
